condition_crosswalk.already_held: 018 adopted pair stops starting/continuing on lease/authority/scope/head mismatch and isolates interim output; 009/019 preserve event/evidence/checkpoint; 032 is unrelated narrow quarantine. 115 only applies after an existing terminal run; 120 models lifecycle-stage mismatch; 125 concerns NFR14 result reception; 118 concerns CI run event generation.
condition_crosswalk.residual: No exact current adopted oracle states all three effect boundaries individually reject an expired-agent effect when the run itself is not otherwise terminal and the fence mismatches. An event may be preserved as stale without the individual tool/artifact/completion effect being explicitly rejected at its boundary. Candidate 126 makes that source condition explicit, without replacing 018 stop/authority behavior.

condition_crosswalk.source_clause: crash後は最後のdurable checkpointからだけ再開
condition_crosswalk.already_held: 009 publishes checkpoint only after durable event/projection and preserves cumulative obligations; 019 rejects a success checkpoint after failed write/projection/replay, reconstructs from failure position, preserves obligations and forbids provider memory/summary-only resume. 120 includes lifecycle checkpoint stage but is unadopted. Consumer IT-AGLC-006 line 40はcrash後の新owner resumeを設計し、current fenceの最大durable checkpointを使う条件を示す。
condition_crosswalk.residual: 候補は最後のdurable checkpoint限定を明示し、同一operation/revision/scopeのcheckpoint lineageを保持する。checkpoint origin attemptと再開時のcurrent attempt/ownerは異なってよく、有効handoffとprovenanceがあればattempt identity差だけで拒否しない。staged/破損/古い/別scope・revision・operationのcheckpointやhandoff不明は再開に使わない。保存方式・handoff実装は特定しない。

Crash後は旧owner/attempt A1/try-2の最大durable checkpoint C7とその来歴を保持し、有効handoff後の新owner/attempt A2/try-1が同じoperation/revision/scopeでC7からのみ再開する。attempt identity差だけでは拒否せず、後続nondurable progressは使わない。

Resume from progress later than the latest durable checkpoint, a staged/corrupt checkpoint, an older checkpoint, provider memory, or intermediate artifact is individually refused.

Missing/stale/conflicting/unknown checkpoint lineage, operation/revision/scope, or required handoff authority makes resume unknown/unfinished. A valid new-owner/new-attempt handoff to the same operation/revision/scope may resume from the latest durable checkpoint whose originating attempt is retained; attempt mismatch alone is not a rejection reason.
